module: Temporary free camera during a vehicle's "recovery" (rewind/respawn). beginRecoveryCamera switches the player seated in that vehicle to free camera, setRecoveryCameraPosRot moves it, endRecoveryCamera restores the game camera. If the player was already in free camera, nothing is changed. In practice called from the vehicle's recovery code.
usage:
core_recoveryCamera.beginRecoveryCamera(vid)
core_recoveryCamera.setRecoveryCameraPosRot(vid, x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw)
core_recoveryCamera.endRecoveryCamera(vid)
notes: The player is found among core_multiseat.getPlayers() (or {0}) via be:getPlayerVehicleID; if nobody is seated in the vehicle, nothing happens.
In multiseat mode, the recovery camera is only active if core_camera.getContextIdForPlayer(player) exists.

beginRecoveryCamera.desc: Starts the recovery camera for the player seated in the vehicle: remembers whether it was already in free camera, otherwise calls commands.setFreeCamera(player).

vehicleId.desc: Id of the vehicle in recovery.

setRecoveryCameraPosRot.desc: Places the player's camera (core_camera.setPosRot). No effect if no recovery is active for this vehicle or if the player was already in free camera.

endRecoveryCamera.desc: Ends the recovery: forgets the state and puts the game camera back (commands.setGameCamera) if the free camera had been enabled by beginRecoveryCamera.

onDespawnObject.desc: Hook called when an object is deleted: forgets a recovery in progress for this vehicle.
